part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-01-ten.ko: tensor의 axis·shape·dtype·device를 구분하고 계산 그래프의 중간값과 연산 의존경로를 추적한다. 작은 곱셈과 합의 손계산을 PyTorch 출력과 대조한다.
part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-01-ten.en: Distinguish tensor axes, shapes, dtypes, and devices while tracing intermediate values and dependencies in a computation graph. Compare small products and sums calculated by hand with PyTorch outputs.

part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-02-sin.ko: 입력의 가중합과 bias에서 pre-activation을 구하고 ReLU를 적용한다. 하나의 neuron에서 affine 변환, activation 전후 값과 연쇄법칙으로 계산한 gradient를 연결한다.
part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-02-sin.en: Calculate a neuron's pre-activation from a weighted sum and bias, then apply ReLU. Connect affine transformations, values before and after activation, and gradients calculated with the chain rule.

part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-03-mlp.ko: 두 층 MLP의 forward pass를 직접 tensor 연산으로 계산한다. 행 단위 batch와 neuron별 weight를 배열하고 입력·hidden·출력 axis와 각 단계의 shape를 검산한다.
part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-03-mlp.en: Calculate a two-layer MLP's forward pass with direct tensor operations. Arrange row-batched samples and neuron weights, then check input, hidden, and output axes and the shapes at each stage.

part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-04-act.ko: 같은 입력에서 ReLU·sigmoid·GELU·SiLU의 함수값과 국소 미분을 비교한다. GLU와 SwiGLU에서 gate가 content 경로를 원소별 곱으로 조절하는 계산을 살펴본다.
part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-04-act.en: Compare ReLU, sigmoid, GELU, and SiLU values and local derivatives at the same inputs. Calculate how GLU and SwiGLU gates modulate the content path through elementwise multiplication.

part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-05-log.ko: logit vector에서 max subtraction을 적용한 softmax, target의 cross entropy와 logit gradient를 계산한다. 정규화 전 점수·확률·loss를 구분한다.
part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-05-log.en: Calculate stable softmax with max subtraction, target cross entropy, and logit gradients from a logit vector. Distinguish unnormalized scores, probabilities, and loss.

part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-06-bac.ko: scalar 계산 그래프를 역순으로 따라 upstream gradient와 국소 미분을 곱하고 분기에서 돌아오는 gradient를 더한다. 손계산을 autograd와 대조하며 backward와 parameter update를 구분한다.
part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-06-bac.en: Trace a scalar computation graph backward, multiply upstream gradients by local derivatives, and add gradients from branches. Compare hand calculations with autograd and separate backward computation from parameter updates.

part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-07-gra.ko: sample별 gradient의 평균으로 mini-batch gradient를 구하고 learning rate를 적용해 한 step을 갱신한다. sum·mean reduction의 scale 차이와 batch sampling·data order의 재현성을 확인한다.
part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-07-gra.en: Average per-sample gradients to obtain a mini-batch gradient and apply one learning-rate update. Check how sum and mean reduction change gradient scale and how sampling and data order affect reproducibility.

part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-08-mom.ko: momentum buffer와 Adam의 moment·bias correction을 계산하고 AdamW의 adaptive update와 weight decay를 구분한다. 학습 재개에 weight뿐 아니라 optimizer state와 step이 필요한 이유를 설명한다.
part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-08-mom.en: Calculate momentum buffers, Adam moments, and bias correction, then distinguish AdamW's adaptive update from weight decay. Examine why training resumption requires optimizer state and steps as well as weights.

part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-09-pyt.ko: PyTorch의 matmul·transpose·broadcasting을 수식의 axis와 대응시킨다. unsqueeze와 reshape의 역할을 구분하고 float32·float64에서 cancellation과 반올림 차이를 확인한다.
part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-09-pyt.en: Match PyTorch matmul, transpose, and broadcasting to equation axes. Distinguish unsqueeze from reshape and compare cancellation and rounding in float32 and float64.

part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-10-aut.ko: 작은 함수의 Jacobian·JVP·VJP를 손으로 구해 torch.func와 대조한다. 입력 tangent와 출력 cotangent의 전달, forward·reverse mode 선택, scalar loss의 역전파를 연결한다.
part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-10-aut.en: Calculate a small function's Jacobian, JVP, and VJP by hand and compare them with torch.func. Connect input tangents, output cotangents, mode selection, and backpropagation of a scalar loss.

part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-11-tok.ko: 고정 toy vocabulary로 문자열을 token과 ID sequence로 바꾼다. token 경계, special·unknown token과 decode의 범위를 구분하고 token 수준 분석을 text span과 대응시킨다.
part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-11-tok.en: Encode text into tokens and ID sequences with a fixed toy vocabulary. Distinguish token boundaries, special and unknown tokens, and decoding limits while mapping token-level analysis to text spans.

part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-12-emb.ko: token ID의 embedding row lookup부터 hidden state의 vocabulary logit 계산까지 shape를 추적한다. weight tying과 선택된 row에 모이는 lookup gradient를 설명한다.
part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-12-emb.en: Trace shapes from embedding-row lookup by token ID to vocabulary logits from hidden states. Examine weight tying and the lookup gradients that accumulate in selected rows.

part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-13-pos.ko: RoPE가 query·key의 feature pair를 위치별로 회전하는 계산을 다룬다. norm과 같은 위치의 내적 보존, 상대 위치에 따른 score 변화와 config의 rotary fraction을 구분한다.
part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-13-pos.en: Calculate RoPE rotations of query and key feature pairs by position. Check norm and same-position dot-product preservation, relative-position effects on scores, and the rotary fraction in model configuration.

part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-14-que.ko: 같은 hidden state에서 query·key·value projection을 계산하고 QK score 행렬의 행·열 의미를 추적한다. score를 만드는 Q·K와 output에서 섞는 V의 역할을 구분한다.
part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-14-que.en: Calculate query, key, and value projections from the same hidden state and trace the rows and columns of the QK score matrix. Distinguish the scoring roles of Q and K from the content supplied by V.

part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-15-cau.ko: QK score의 크기 조절, causal mask, 행별 softmax, value 가중합을 순서대로 계산한다. mask 적용 순서와 output shape를 검산하고 attention weight와 최종 예측의 인과 기여를 구분한다.
part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-15-cau.en: Calculate causal scaled dot-product attention through score scaling, masking, row-wise softmax, and value mixing. Check mask order and output shapes, and distinguish attention weights from causal contributions to a prediction.

part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-16-mha.ko: MHA·MQA·GQA에서 query head와 key-value head의 수·배정·shape를 비교한다. K·V 공유에 따른 KV cache 크기를 계산하고 공유 경로에 개입하는 범위를 구분한다.
part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-16-mha.en: Compare query and key-value head counts, assignments, and shapes in MHA, MQA, and GQA. Calculate KV cache sizes under K/V sharing and distinguish the scope of interventions on shared paths.

part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-17-res.ko: attention·MLP update가 residual stream에 더해지는 순서를 추적한다. sublayer output과 덧셈 뒤 상태를 구분하고 residual Jacobian의 identity 경로를 확인한다.
part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-17-res.en: Trace how attention and MLP updates enter the residual stream. Distinguish sublayer outputs from post-addition states and identify the identity path in the residual Jacobian.

part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-18-lay.ko: 작은 vector에 LayerNorm과 RMSNorm을 적용해 centering·rescaling·학습 parameter를 비교한다. pre-norm과 post-norm의 계산 순서를 따라 activation과 hook 위치를 구분한다.
part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-18-lay.en: Apply LayerNorm and RMSNorm to small vectors and compare centering, rescaling, and learned parameters. Follow pre-norm and post-norm computation order to distinguish activations and hook locations.

part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-19-den.ko: dense MLP와 SwiGLU의 forward 식·shape를 계산하고 top-1 MoE routing을 비교한다. content를 조절하는 gate와 expert 선택을 구분하며 전체 parameter와 token당 활성 parameter를 나눠 센다.
part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-19-den.en: Calculate dense MLP and SwiGLU expressions and shapes, then compare top-1 MoE routing. Distinguish content gating from expert selection and count total versus per-token active parameters.

part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-20-dec.ko: tiny decoder에서 token ID부터 logit까지 embedding·attention·normalization·MLP·residual 계산을 연결한다. 공개 모델 config와의 component·순서·공유 차이를 구분해 hook 대응을 확인한다.
part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-20-dec.en: Connect embeddings, attention, normalization, MLPs, and residual updates from token IDs to logits in a tiny decoder. Compare components, ordering, and sharing with public model configurations before matching hooks.

part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-21-lan.ko: sequence 확률을 prefix 조건부 확률의 곱으로 나타내고 next-token logit·label의 shift를 표시한다. 유효 token의 NLL과 mean loss를 계산하며 teacher forcing과 autoregressive 생성을 구분한다.
part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-21-lan.en: Factor sequence probabilities into prefix-conditioned terms and align next-token logits with shifted labels. Calculate NLL and mean loss over valid tokens, distinguishing teacher forcing from autoregressive generation.

part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-22-cau.ko: causal 언어모델 생성에서 과거 K·V를 저장하고 새 token의 projection을 추가하는 KV cache 계산을 다룬다. layer별 cache shape·memory를 구하고 cached logit을 전체 forward와 대조한다.
part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-22-cau.en: Run causal language-model generation by caching past keys and values and appending new token projections. Calculate per-layer cache shapes and memory, then compare cached logits with a full forward pass.

part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-23-dec.ko: greedy와 categorical sampling을 비교하고 temperature·top-k·top-p에 따른 후보 분포를 계산한다. 절단 뒤 재정규화와 seed·prompt 조건을 확인해 생성 차이의 원인을 구분한다.
part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-23-dec.en: Compare greedy decoding and categorical sampling, and calculate candidate distributions under temperature, top-k, and top-p. Check renormalization and seed/prompt conditions when interpreting differences in generated text.

part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-24-cha.ko: 생성된 chain-of-thought를 output token에 관한 행동 관찰로 다룬다. legibility·correctness·faithfulness와 CoT·activation 개입의 차이를 구분해 내부 계산에 관한 주장 범위를 검토한다.
part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-24-cha.en: Treat generated chain-of-thought as behavioral evidence about output tokens. Distinguish legibility, correctness, and faithfulness, and compare CoT and activation interventions when assessing claims about internal computation.

part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-25-hoo.ko: module·layer·token 위치를 지정해 forward hook으로 activation을 수집한다. detach·clone·device 이동과 handle 제거를 구분하고 호출 횟수·shape·dtype·저장량·provenance를 확인한다.
part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-25-hoo.en: Collect activations with forward hooks at specified modules, layers, and token positions. Distinguish detach, clone, device transfer, and handle removal while checking calls, shapes, dtypes, storage, and provenance.

part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-26-gra.ko: scalar 분석 target을 정해 non-leaf activation의 gradient를 수집한다. perturbation과의 내적으로 일차 변화를 근사하고 실제 개입 forward와 대조해 국소 민감도와 인과 효과를 구분한다.
part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-26-gra.en: Define a scalar analysis target and collect gradients of non-leaf activations. Approximate first-order changes through gradient–perturbation inner products and compare intervention forwards to distinguish local sensitivity from causal effects.

part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-27-che.ko: parameter·persistent buffer·optimizer state를 구분하고 inference와 학습 재개 checkpoint의 요구 항목을 정리한다. strict key 검사와 forward 일치로 load를 검증하며 revision·step·seed를 기록한다.
part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-27-che.en: Distinguish parameters, persistent buffers, and optimizer state in inference and resumable-training checkpoints. Validate loading through strict key checks and forward equivalence, recording revisions, steps, and seeds.

part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-28-one.ko: 한 token의 ID부터 vocabulary logit까지 tensor 경로를 종합 실습으로 추적한다. shape·residual 등식·선택 logit의 embedding gradient를 확인하고 full forward와 cached inference를 대조한다.
part-2-neural-computation/N05/N05-28-one.en: Trace one token from its ID to vocabulary logits in an integrated lab. Check shapes, residual equalities, and the embedding gradient of a selected logit, then compare full forward computation with cached inference.
